description.value: Fish With You (鱼你在一起) is a Chinese restaurant on Kingsway specialising in fish dishes such as Szechuan Pepper Suancai Fish and Royal Tomato Fish. The restaurant offers dine-in with indoor seating and takeout, making it a potential mid-ride meal stop in the Burnaby/Vancouver border stretch of Kingsway. Its OSM record was last checked in late 2025, suggesting the Vancouver location is active.
